rows.text: During the early attempts to replicate the Astral Express, the Technology Department struggled to solve the engine's power issue. The Intelligentsia Guild proposed using antimatter to replace the power of Trailblaze, with this controller serving as a matching component. The original design concept was simple: just like adjusting the hot and cold water ratio in a shower head, one could control the Express's speed by cleverly adjusting the injection rate of matter and antimatter with a wrench. However, prototype testing always ended in annihilating explosions. After all, getting the water temperature right was never an easy task.
